systems_note: Inovelli's Blue Series is its Zigbee line.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: Works with or without a neutral, handles 3-way with your existing switches, and doubles as an on/off switch.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.why: Pairs straight to Echo devices with a Zigbee hub, and has the most reviews of any Zigbee dimmer we found.

awards.label: Most Flexible
awards.why: Runs as Zigbee or Matter over Thread, works without a neutral, and lets you set brightness limits.

awards.label: Best for Big Loads
awards.why: Rated for 300 W of LED, double most smart dimmers.

specs.extras: Dimmer or on/off, custom LED bar

products.verdict: The enthusiast's pick. One switch that can be a dimmer or an on/off switch, with or without a neutral, and a customizable LED bar.
pros: Works with or without a neutral wire
Use existing switches in a 3-way, or add Inovelli's Aux switch
Set up as a dimmer or on/off switch
cons: Sold by a reseller with 1 left in stock at capture time
The listing never says Zigbee; Blue Series is Inovelli's Zigbee line
Neutral installs unlock the most features

specs.hub: Echo with Zigbee hub, or any Zigbee 3.0 hub

products.verdict: The most-reviewed Zigbee dimmer we found. It pairs directly with Echo devices that have a Zigbee hub built in.
pros: Pairs with Echo Studio, Echo Show 10, and Echo Plus with no extra hub

specs.hub: Aqara hub (Zigbee) or Thread border router (Matter)
specs.extras: Forward and reverse phase, brightness limits

products.verdict: A Zigbee or Thread dimmer that works without a neutral and lets you cap brightness to stop LED flicker.
pros: Choose Zigbee or Matter over Thread
Works with or without a neutral
cons: Zigbee mode needs an Aqara hub for full features

products.verdict: A Zigbee 3.0 certified Decora dimmer with a 300 W LED rating, the highest here.
pros: 300 W LED and 600 W incandescent rating
Up to four DD00R remotes for 3-way dimming
Works with Echo hubs and SmartThings
cons: Usually ships in 7 to 8 days from a third-party seller

avoid.flag: No bullets, no load rating, no wiring details
avoid.verdict: The listing has no product bullets at all, so there's no load rating, wiring requirement, or box size to check before you buy.
reasons: There are no feature bullets on the listing, only a long keyword title.
Nothing says whether it needs a neutral or how many watts of LED it can handle.
The title misspells the Echo it claims to work with ("Amazon Ehco Plus").
